To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

CobiT, an information technology internal control framework, is an appropriate model for understanding the internal controls that auditors believe are important for information technology systems, and that CobiT can be used to predict auditor behaviors in the field.
CobiT is an appropriate internal control framework for IT, and that CobiT provides a useful model for understanding the relationship between the underlying constructs in the IT audit environment.
CobiT provides a useful and valid conceptual model for understanding the internal controls that are needed in IT-intensive organizations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a general theory of control applicable to IT systems.
the application of the CobiT control framework to the audit of IT systems.
the internal consistency of the conceptual model that CobiT uses to organize and present the internal control practices of IT.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CobiT is an effective and efficient framework that provides a common basis for the development and evaluation of internal controls for technology intensive information systems.
the CobiT model is a useful framework for developing and testing a general theory of information technology internal control.
the CobiT framework is a valid and reliable framework for assessing internal controls over IT and IT related processes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found CobiT to be a useful conceptual model of IT internal control.
the results of this paper provide a strong empirical basis for the use of the CobiT framework in an audit setting.
the results of this research support CobiT's use as an internal control model for IT systems, and that the model is consistent with the behavior of IT auditors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CobiT framework provides a useful conceptual model for understanding the internal control of information systems.
CobiT is a useful framework for developing and assessing information systems.
CobiT is not a set of control objectives that can be used to evaluate the effectiveness of an organization's IT controls in isolation.
